topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: I always figured we'd stay in our little digital bubble, safe from the surprises of the real world. Turns out, life has a quirky sense of humor. My online friend, someone I've known for years, ended up living in the same city. I thought it would be exciting, a chance to finally meet in person, to turn screens into faces. But now, the thought of it just feels overwhelming. The last thing I want is to ruin what we have. Maybe it's better to keep things as they are, even if it means passing them on the street without ever saying hello.
